text:
maria (procurement): Heads-up: Hyperline just flagged a split-shipment proposal for the upcoming GPU wave. They want 60% sea / 40% air. Concern: FRA dock-snags + customs slowdown could delay critical racks. They also said RMA labels will be 'generic' unless we confirm format. Thoughts?

kevin (logistics): Can we hedge by contracting two forwarders and routing 30 units via air priority, rest by sea? Air delta looks ~+12% on cost but saves deploy risk.

alex (vendor:hyperline): We can do split AWBs. ETA air ~7d, sea ~18d. Insurance options: basic (carrier default) or CIF with declared value coverage (~$120k extra). RMA labels: we can include pre-printed return stickers, but serialized manifest must be supplied as a separate CSV file from Redwood.

siva (ops): We need the serialized manifest up-front to avoid customs/manifest mismatches. Our depot intake parser expects HS code 8471.80 and columns: serial, model, mfg_date, vendor_sku. If vendor labels don't match our format, depot will manually triage and that'll add 24-48h.

maria (procurement): If a dock snag happens, contingency? Can vendor add a re-route clause + standby air uplift option to move the backlog if FRA blocks? Also need confirmation on RMA return-flow for DOA units shipped in same wave.

alex (vendor:hyperline): We can add a re-route clause and standby uplift. Standby air uplift cost = +11% on those units, re-route clause included in proforma. For DOA: we process replacements separately but can include pre-printed RMA op stickers for depots. Will provide CSV template.

kevin (logistics): Operational request: attach a CSV with header, please match exactly 15 helps automatic ingest. Example header we need:

serial,model,mfg_date,vendor_sku

Also confirm whether refurbished/DOA replacements share the same shipping carton labeling or will be segregated.

alex (vendor:hyperline): CSV will be provided. Replacements will be segregated and flagged in the manifest under `status` column (we'll add that column). If you cannot accept that extra column, tell us and we'll keep a separate file.

siva (ops): We can accept the `status` column but it must be one of: NEW, DOA, REFURB. If customs reclass/valuation change happens, we need 2x baseline insurance. Add vendor notification SLA: notify Redwood within 12h of any delay >48h or any customs hold.

maria (procurement): Agreed on notification SLA. Alex, please confirm the uplift for split AWBs + standby air and upload a sample label + CSV template to the shared folder by EOD. Also confirm AWB placeholders so we can pre-seed our trackers.

alex (vendor:hyperline): Confirmed: uplift for split AWB + standby = +11%. Sample label and CSV template uploaded: https://drive.redwood/inbound/175001. AWB placeholders: AIR-PLHD12345, SEA-PLHD67890.

logistics-bot: Booking created in pilot queue BK-175001. Watchers: kevin, siva.

kevin (logistics): I'll review the uplift and standby wording in the SLA. If the clause prevents lost deploys, we approve up to +12%. @maria you good to sign-off on that ceiling?

maria (procurement): Approve up to +12% total uplift if it materially reduces deploy risk. Proceed and get manifest + labels by EOD so ops can validate.

alex (vendor:hyperline): Understood 15 proceeding. Will push final manifest + sample labels to folder and ping this thread when done.

kevin (logistics): Quick checklist for Alex before booking completes: 1) CSV present with the exact header (or agreed extra `status` enum), 2) sample PDF label matching our depot parser, 3) re-route & standby clause in the proforma, 4) declared-insurance option shown as separate line item.

siva (ops): Also add a pointer to the serialized manifest checksum (sha256) in the folder so our intake can auto-verify file integrity. Example command we use to verify: `sha256sum manifest.csv`

alex (vendor:hyperline): Will include checksum and separate DOA manifest if you prefer. Will update within 6 hours.

maria (procurement): Thanks all 15 marking this as active. We'll escalate to legal for the re-route wording if hyperline's standard T&Cs block the SLA.

kevin (logistics): Noted. I'll stand by to approve final booking once files + clauses verified.
